summary: Iteration 9 - Comprehensive E2E frontend testing completed. All major flows tested successfully: Landing page, Registration (Customer Nepodnikatel, Supplier OSVČ with ARES), Login, Customer Dashboard, Demand Creation, Profile Edit, Admin Dashboard. All features working correctly.

issues: Uses browser's default date picker instead of custom shadcn calendar component - minor UX inconsistency

success_rate.backend: 100% (verified via curl - health, categories, geocode, ARES all working)

seed_data_creation: Created test customer (nepodnikatel) and test supplier (OSVČ) during E2E testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major E2E flows tested and working. Registration for all user types works correctly. ARES lookup, geocoding, category selection, demand creation, profile editing all functional. The user-reported EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED error could not be reproduced - registration works correctly on preview URL.

LANDING_PAGE.details: Hero section, stat icons (SMS/99Kč/RealTime), navigation links, pricing section, footer all visible and working

REGISTRATION_CUSTOMER_NEPODNIKATEL.details: 4-step flow: basic -> role -> customer_type -> details. Address autocomplete with geocoding works. No IČO required for nepodnikatel.

REGISTRATION_SUPPLIER_OSVC.details: 5-step flow: basic -> role -> supplier_type -> details -> categories. ARES lookup fills company name and DIČ. Category filter and custom category suggestion work.

LOGIN.details: Login with email/password works. Redirects to correct dashboard based on role (customer/supplier/admin).

CUSTOMER_DASHBOARD.details: Stat cards (total/open/in_progress/completed), new demand button, filtered demands modal all working.

DEMAND_CREATION.details: Title, description, category selection, address autocomplete with map, payment method selection, deadline picker all working.

ADDRESS_AUTOCOMPLETE.details: Geocoding API returns suggestions, clicking suggestion fills address and shows map marker.

ARES_LOOKUP.details: Entering IČO and clicking 'Načíst z ARES' auto-fills company_name, DIČ, and address.

CATEGORY_SELECTION.details: 61 categories available, filter search works, multi-select works, custom category suggestion works.

PROFILE_VIEW_EDIT.details: Profile view shows all user info. Edit mode allows updating name, phone, bio, address. Photo upload menu visible.

ADMIN_DASHBOARD.details: Shows user stats (103 users, 63 customers, 38 suppliers), order stats, recent orders list.

SUPPLIER_DASHBOARD.details: 4 expandable tabs (Dostupné/Rozdělané/Dokončené/Nedokončené), finance widget, trial period info.

mocked_apis.Stripe: Payment integration is MOCKED - uses sk_test_emergent

rca_of_the_issue: The user-reported EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED error could not be reproduced on the preview URL. Registration completes successfully and redirects to dashboard. The fix from iteration 8 (using BackgroundTasks for email) appears to be working correctly.
